lines.en: label harukaspring5:
scene harukasanabar1

{size=-2}Every once in a while, Haruka Hamasaki liked to come to the bar and stare absentmindedly into the mouth of a can, wondering how much it would hurt if she were to kiss it the way she dreamt of kissing teenage girls.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}每隔一阵子，Haruka Hamasaki 就喜欢来这间酒吧，呆呆地盯着罐口，想着要是像她梦见亲吻少女那样去亲它，会有多疼。{/size}

lines.en: {size=-2}It wasn’t really a suitable replacement by any means, but it did occupy a slot in her brain that would be otherwise spent on fabricated depression, loneliness, or some other human fallacy that things like me can’t comprehend.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-2}这算不上什么像样的替代品，但它确实占住了她脑子里的一块地方——不然那块地方就会被臆想出来的抑郁、孤独，或是别的什么我这类存在无法理解的人性谬误填满。{/size}

lines.en: {size=-4}For despite her voluptuous appearance and her status as a decently well-known person in a decently unknown town thanks to her decently successful business, who she was to everyone else did not match who she was to herself.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}因为，尽管她身材丰腴，又靠着一门还算成功的生意在一个相当无名的小镇上成了个相当有名的人物，她在别人眼里的样子，和她自己眼里的样子并不相符。{/size}

lines.en: The same could be said for most, though.
lines.zh: 不过，这对大多数人来说都一样。

lines.en: That every human being who’s ever stared into the mouth of a can has been hiding {i}something.{/i}
lines.zh: 每一个曾经盯着罐口发呆的人，都藏着{i}什么{/i}。

lines.en: Whether it be thoughts of kissing or killing or some other word that starts with k since alliteration is all the rage these days.
lines.zh: 藏的是亲吻的念头也好，杀人的念头也好，或是别的什么以 K 开头的词——毕竟押头韵如今正流行。

lines.en: Also, she was never thinking that thing I told you she was thinking because that would be weird.
lines.zh: 另外，她可没有在想我刚说她在想的那种事，因为那太奇怪了。

lines.en: She was mostly just wondering why it was always so dark in there when there was clearly an opening for light to find a new home.
lines.zh: 她多半只是在想，明明开了个口子，光完全可以照进去安家，为什么里面总是那么黑。

lines.en: It’s something I think sometimes too when I get mad at you for still being here and need to lash out. And that’s doubly annoying because I’ve already found the answer.
lines.zh: 这件事我有时也会想——尤其在我因为你还在而恼火、想找人撒气的时候。而这加倍让人烦躁，因为我早就找到答案了。

lines.en: Some things are just never meant to be illuminated. We can’t {i}all{/i} be dust, you know?
lines.zh: 有些东西注定永远不会被照亮。你知道的，我们不可能{i}全都{/i}是尘埃。

lines.en: Yet as she gazed once more into an abyss that would never gaze back at her, she remembered how she got here. How her legs still work and how her mind was strong enough to compel them to take her.
lines.zh: 然而，当她再次凝视那个永远不会回望她的深渊时，她想起了自己是怎么走到这一步的。她的双腿还能动，她的意志也还强到足以命令它们把她带到这里。

lines.en: And she thought that was pretty cool.
lines.zh: 她觉得这还挺酷的。

lines.en: Because after everything she’d been through and everything she’d seen — every night alone or night spent wishing — she could still open her mouth and taste one of humanity’s finest creations.
lines.zh: 因为在她所经历的一切、所见过的一切之后——每一个孤独的夜晚，或是每一个在祈愿中度过的夜晚之后——她依然能张开嘴，尝一尝人类最伟大的发明之一。

lines.en: Not beer, but curiosity. For she was one of many who had found comfort in the balancing act between {i}that{/i} and duty.
lines.zh: 不是啤酒，而是好奇心。因为她和许多人一样，在{i}好奇心{/i}与责任之间的走钢丝里找到了慰藉。

lines.en: But of course, that didn’t mean she would always make the right choice. Which is why she sometimes raped girls at Christmalloween parties.
lines.zh: 当然，这并不意味着她总能做出正确的选择。所以她偶尔会在圣诞万圣派对上强暴女孩。

lines.en: : You guys ever wonder how we even get this stuff?
lines.zh: : 你们有没有想过，这些东西到底是怎么运进来的？

lines.en: : Like, if Kumon-mi is closed to the outside world, where do all of these supplies like beer or coffee keep coming from? Because it’s not like there’s enough space here to produce it all.
lines.zh: : 比如说，Kumon-mi 既然与外界隔绝，那啤酒、咖啡这些补给到底是从哪儿一直来的？这儿可没那么大的地方生产这些东西。

lines.en: scene harukasanabar2
: You don’t know where your coffee comes from, Haru-chan? I thought that was super important information for all of those snobby coffee people who come into your shop.
lines.zh: : 你不知道你的咖啡是从哪儿来的吗，Haru-chan？我还以为对那些进你店里的势利咖啡客来说，这是特别重要的信息呢。

lines.en: : No, I {i}do{/i} know where it comes from. I just don’t know how it gets {i}here.{/i}
lines.zh: : 不，我{i}当然{/i}知道它是从哪儿来的。我只是不知道它是怎么到{i}这儿{/i}来的。

lines.en: : There’s probably some kind of...gate in the wall somewhere, isn’t there? Or maybe things come in by...helicopter?
lines.zh: : 墙上大概有某种……门之类的吧？还是说，东西是用……直升机运进来的？

lines.en: : Probably that. There’s a helipad at the hospital. Maybe they do supply drops or something?
lines.zh: : 大概是那样吧。医院有个停机坪。说不定他们会空投补给什么的？

lines.en: : Why, though? Like, is this some sort of national government funded effort? Because it’s not like we give anything {i}back{/i} to them.
lines.zh: : 可为什么呢？这是不是某种国家政府资助的项目？我们又没给过他们任何{i}回报{/i}。

lines.en: : I guess that’s true, yeah. Our main export was Niki until she started sleeping with Sensei every night. Hard to put out new music when there’s a penis inside of you. What’s this all about, though?
lines.zh: : 我想也是，没错。我们主要的出口产品本来是 Niki，直到她开始每晚和 Sensei 上床。身体里插着一根阴茎的时候，很难出新歌。不过，你到底想说什么？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : You seem off tonight.
lines.zh: : 你今晚不太对劲。

lines.en: : Contemplative.
lines.zh: : 若有所思。

lines.en: : Yeah. Whatever Sana just said.
lines.zh: : 对。就是 Sana 刚说的那个。

lines.en: : Like you’re lost in thought instead of relaxing...which would imply that something is wrong.
lines.zh: : 就像你陷在思绪里，而不是在放松……这说明出事了。

lines.en: : Tell us what you require, Haru-chan. Sana and I will steal away your worries and secretly ship them off to Tokyo in the next batch of Niki exports.
lines.zh: : 告诉我们你需要什么，Haru-chan。Sana 和我会把你的烦恼偷走，混在下一批 Niki 出口货里偷偷运去东京。

lines.en: : Oh, cool. I didn’t realize the bar now doubled as a psychology clinic.
lines.zh: : 哦，厉害。我都不知道这酒吧现在还兼职心理诊所了。

lines.en: scene harukasanabar3
: Then you don’t know what you’re talking about since bartenders are the {i}original{/i} psychologists. Why study the mind at all when you can just booze it up and fix everything that way?
lines.zh: : 那你就外行了，酒保才是{i}最初的{/i}心理医生。既然能靠灌酒解决一切，何必去研究什么心智？

lines.en: : I think that contradicts your “drink responsibly” sign near the door.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这跟你门口那块「适量饮酒」的牌子自相矛盾。

lines.en: : That’s only there for legal purposes. And I’ll have you know that I was drinking {i}irresponsibly{/i} when I put it up, which just further proves my point that alcohol is medicine.
lines.zh: : 那块牌子只是为了应付法律责任。而且我告诉你，我挂那块牌子的时候可是{i}「不适量」{/i}地喝着呢，这更证明了酒精就是药。

lines.en: : Didn’t your dad used to get drunk and beat you?
lines.zh: : 你爸以前不是喝醉了就打你吗？

lines.en: : Sana, dear — could you get Haru-chan another beer? She’s clearly still incapable of unwinding and so we must act as a team to repair her and stop dredging up other people’s past traumas.
lines.zh: : Sana，亲爱的——能给 Haru-chan 再拿瓶啤酒吗？她显然还是放松不下来，所以我们必须团队合作把她修好，并且停止翻别人的旧伤疤。

lines.en: scene harukasanabar4
: We already used up the last of what we had in the cooler...I figured we’d just restock it tomorrow morning or something.
lines.zh: : 冷藏箱里的酒我们已经喝光了……我本来想明早再补货什么的。

lines.en: : We have another crate in back, baby. From Monday’s mysterious supply drop.
lines.zh: : 宝贝，后面还有一箱呢。周一那次神秘空投来的。

lines.en: : Could you get it, maybe? The crates back there are too heavy for me as I am just a weak little girl...
lines.zh: : 那你能去拿一下吗？后面那些箱子对我来说太重了，我只是个弱小的小女孩……

lines.en: scene harukasanabar5
: Fiiiiiiine. But only because I love you and blame myself for passing down my petite and frail genetics onto you.
lines.zh: : 好——吧。不过只是因为我爱你，而且我怪自己把你这娇小柔弱的基因遗传给了你。

lines.en: : Thanks, Mom. I love you too.
lines.zh: : 谢了，妈妈。我也爱你。

lines.en: scene harukasanabar6
: I love you {i}more,{/i} though.
lines.zh: : 不过，我{i}更{/i}爱你。

lines.en: : Nuh-uh. That’s impossible.
lines.zh: : 才没有。那不可能。

lines.en: : Nooooope! Nothing is impossible when you love someone as much as I love {i}you!{/i}
lines.zh: : 才——不！只要{i}你{/i}爱我爱的那么深，就没有什么不可能！

lines.en: : That’s just what {i}you{/i} think...And we both know I’m the smarter one here, so you should listen to me when I tell you that you’re wrong.
lines.zh: : 那只是{i}你{/i}这么想……而且我们都清楚这儿我更聪明，所以我告诉你你错了的时候，你该听我的。

lines.en: scene harukasanabar7
: I am {i}not{/i} wrong! But we’ll continue this when I get back so Haru-chan doesn’t go thirsty and die. Love you!
lines.zh: : 我{i}才没错{/i}！不过这事等我回来再继续，免得 Haru-chan 渴死。爱你！

lines.en: : Love you, Mom.
lines.zh: : 爱你，妈妈。

lines.en: scene harukasanabar8
: What the fuck was {i}that{/i} about?
lines.zh: : 刚才{i}那{/i}是些什么玩意儿？

lines.en: scene harukasanabar9
: What do you mean, Haruka? Did you notice something strange?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思，Haruka？你注意到什么奇怪的地方了吗？

lines.en: : Yes! Very much, yes!
lines.zh: : 有！非常，非常有！

lines.en: : Like, Sara professing her love to you is par for the course. She does that every day. And even when you’re not here, she never shuts up about it.
lines.zh: : 你看，Sara 对你示爱那是家常便饭。她每天都那样。就算你不在，她也说个没完。

lines.en: : Since when you feed back into it, though?
lines.zh: : 可你从什么时候开始回应她了？

lines.en: : Have I not always done that?...
lines.zh: : 我一直都那样吧？……

lines.en: : No! You’re normally all like, “Stop embarrassing me...” or “Not in front of the customers...” And then you just flat out ignore her sometimes. Are you drunk? Because you don’t {i}look{/i} drunk.
lines.zh: : 才没有！你平时都是「别丢人了……」「别当着客人的面……」有时候你干脆直接无视她。你喝醉了吗？可你{i}看起来{/i}不像醉了。

lines.en: : Hmm...I guess that {i}is{/i} kind of weird, now that you mention it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……你这么一说，好像{i}确实{/i}有点奇怪。

lines.en: : Is it, like...has the whole thing with Yuki maybe helped you realize that your relationship with Sara is fleeting and something you need to cherish while you still have the chance?
lines.zh: : 是不是……比如，和 Yuki 那档子事让你意识到，你和 Sara 的关系转瞬即逝，得趁还有机会的时候好好珍惜？

lines.en: : No...I think it was probably just the threesome.
lines.zh: : 不是……我觉得大概只是因为那场三人行。

lines.en: scene harukasanabar10
: The what?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene harukasanabar11
: Oh, she didn’t tell you?
lines.zh: : 哦，她没告诉你吗？

lines.en: : Tell me what?! What are you even talking about?!
lines.zh: : 告诉我什么？！你到底在说什么？！

lines.en: : Obviously the two of us having sex with Sensei together. It probably strengthened our familial bond and made us love each other more.
lines.zh: : 当然是我和她一起跟 Sensei 上床啊。这大概加深了我们的亲情，让我们更爱彼此了。

lines.en: : Okay. Where are the cameras? Sara’s probably right behind that door filming my reaction, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 好。摄像头在哪儿？Sara 大概就在那扇门后面拍我的反应，对吧？

lines.en: : There are no cameras. Is this really that unbelievable to you?
lines.zh: : 没有摄像头。这对你来说真的那么难以置信吗？

lines.en: scene harukasanabar12
: Yes, because you’re making it up! Sara would never do that with her own {i}daughter!{/i}
lines.zh: : 是，因为你在瞎编！Sara 绝不会和她自己的{i}女儿{/i}做那种事！

lines.en: : She sure would. But if it makes you feel any better, it did take a lot of convincing.
lines.zh: : 她当然会。不过要是这能让你好受点，说服她确实费了不少功夫。

lines.en: : Wait, so...you convinced {i}her?!{/i} This was {i}your{/i} idea?!
lines.zh: : 等等，所以……是你说服{i}她{/i}的？！这是{i}你的{/i}主意？！

lines.en: scene harukasanabar13

: Of course it was my idea. She was never going to invite me into any of the fun {i}she{/i} gets to have with Sensei. So I bridged the gap between our relationships and now we can all be happy {i}together.{/i}
lines.zh: : 当然是我的主意。她永远不可能主动邀我加入{i}她{/i}和 Sensei 的那些「乐子」。所以我弥合了我们两段关系之间的鸿沟，现在我们可以{i}一起{/i}幸福了。

lines.en: : You...but...but Sara isn’t...
lines.zh: : 你……可是……可是 Sara 不是……

lines.en: : Isn’t what? There’s no need to be shy. I’ll tell you everything because I know {i}you{/i} won’t tell anyone else about it.
lines.zh: : 不是什么？不用害羞。我会把一切都告诉{i}你{/i}，因为我知道你不会告诉别人。

lines.en: : How...do you know that? How can you be so sure I won’t-
lines.zh: : 你怎么……知道的？你怎么能这么肯定我不会——

lines.en: : Did you have fun with Kirin at the party?
lines.zh: : 你在派对上和 Kirin 玩得开心吗？

lines.en: scene harukasanabar14
: Like, I obviously knew what the two of you were getting up to when I bumped into you in the hallway. What I didn’t really get was why Kirin seemed so reluctant?
lines.zh: : 你看，我在走廊撞见你们俩的时候，显然就知道你们在搞什么。我不太明白的是，Kirin 为什么看起来那么不情愿？

lines.en: : She’s always talking about older women and sex and hitting on everybody but, when push comes to shove, I guess she’s kind of innocent too, huh?
lines.zh: : 她总是把年上女性、性和搭讪挂在嘴边，可真到了关键时刻，我猜她其实也挺纯情的吧？

lines.en: scene harukasanabar15
: Aw...what’s that face for? You don’t have to worry about me revealing your little secret. It’s totally natural and normal for people your age to be attracted to girls like me.
lines.zh: : 哎呀……你那是什么表情？不用担心我会泄露你的小秘密。你这个年纪的人被我这样的女孩吸引，完全是自然而然、天经地义的事。

lines.en: : Now, taking them into a bathroom they clearly don’t want to go to and doing all sorts of stuff to them is a little {i}less{/i} normal, sure. But hey, some of us actually {i}want{/i} that. Some of us think it’s {i}hot.{/i}
lines.zh: : 当然啦，把人家拖进明显不想去的洗手间、对人家做各种事情，就稍微{i}不那么{/i}正常了。可是嘿，我们有些人就是{i}想要{/i}那样。有些人觉得那样很{i}带劲{/i}。

lines.en: : I bet you still think about it too, don’t you? Alone in bed at night...remembering how {i}soft{/i} she was...her smell...inching closer and closer to cumming as you clench your teeth and spread your legs...
lines.zh: : 我打赌你现在还在想那件事，对吧？夜里一个人躺在床上……回忆她有多{i}柔软{/i}……她的气味……咬紧牙关、张开双腿，一点一点逼近高潮……

lines.en: : What do you want?...
lines.zh: : 你想要什么？……

lines.en: scene harukasanabar16
: Hm?
: You...You’re blackmailing me, right? Is it money? Or...just...what do you {i}want?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你……你是在勒索我，对吧？要钱吗？还是……只是……你到底{i}想{/i}要什么？

lines.en: : I don’t really want anything. I just wanted to tell somebody about my threesome and I know we’ll keep each other’s secrets safe.
lines.zh: : 我其实什么都不想要。我只是想把我的三人行告诉别人，而我知道我们会替对方保守秘密。

lines.en: scene harukasanabar17
: Frankly speaking, {i}I{/i} don’t really care who finds out. I know my mom does, though. She’s still ashamed of it for now, but that’ll wear down over time.
lines.zh: : 坦白说，{i}我{/i}其实不在乎被谁知道。不过我知道我妈在乎。她现在还为此感到羞耻，但时间久了就会淡下去的。

lines.en: : Over...time?
lines.zh: : 时间……久了？

lines.en: : Of course. That was {i}way{/i} too fun to be a one-time thing. And I imagine there will be plenty of nights in the future where we take turns letting Sensei fuck our brains out again.
lines.zh: : 当然。那{i}太{/i}好玩了，不可能只来一次。我能想象，将来会有很多个夜晚，我们轮流让 Sensei 再把我们的脑子操出来。

lines.en: : Heck, maybe things even get to the point where we {i}can’t{/i} get him to come over and have to take care of each other instead? Anything’s possible, right?
lines.zh: : 搞不好，甚至会发展到{i}叫不动{/i}他过来、只能我们互相解决的地步？什么都有可能，对吧？

lines.en: : You’re...actually serious. This is real. It’s not a joke and I’m not just...imagining it.
lines.zh: : 你……是认真的。这是真的。不是玩笑，我也没有……在想象。

lines.en: scene harukasanabar18
: Do you imagine things like this often?
lines.zh: : 你经常想象这种事吗？

lines.en: : No wonder you only hire cute girls at Koi Cafe. I bet you want to fuck them {i}all,{/i} don’t you?
lines.zh: : 难怪 Koi Cafe 只雇可爱的女孩。我打赌你想把她们{i}全都{/i}操一遍，对吧？

lines.en: : M...Maybe...
: Ever think of {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 想过{i}我{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene harukasanabar19
: Are you {i}jealous{/i} now? That Sensei got to have {i}both{/i} little Sakakibara girls at once while you were fingering yourself to that time you molested one of my classmates?
lines.zh: : 你现在是{i}嫉妒{/i}了吗？Sensei 能一次拥有{i}两个{/i}小小的 Sakakibara 家的女孩，而你只能一边自慰，一边回想你猥亵我同学那次？

lines.en: : You can tell me, Haruka. I won’t get you in trouble...
lines.zh: : 你可以告诉我，Haruka。我不会害你惹上麻烦的……

lines.en: : In fact, I wouldn’t tell even if you dragged {i}me{/i} into the bathroom to fulfill your {i}forbidden urges.{/i}
lines.zh: : 事实上，就算你{i}把我{/i}拖进洗手间去满足你那些{i}禁忌的冲动{/i}，我也不会说出去。

lines.en: : If things like {i}that{/i} turned me off, I wouldn’t be so addicted to someone like Sensei in the first place.
lines.zh: : 要是{i}那种事{/i}能让我倒胃口，我一开始就不会对 Sensei 这种人上瘾了。

lines.en: : I...Sana...
lines.zh: : 我……Sana……

lines.en: : You’re...my best friend’s daughter...
lines.zh: : 你是……我最好朋友的女儿……

lines.en: : We both know that just makes it hotter...
lines.zh: : 我们心里都清楚，这只会让它更带劲……

lines.en: scene harukasanabar20
: Can I watch next time?
lines.zh: : 下次我能在旁边看吗？

lines.en: scene harukasanabar21
: PFFFFHHAAAAH! HAHAHAHAH! AAAAHAHAHAHAHAH!
lines.zh: PFFFFHHAAAAH! HAHAHAHAH! AAAAHAHAHAHAHAH!

lines.en: : Is...Is that a no?...
lines.zh: : 这……这是不行吗？……

lines.en: : You don’t even want to join in?! You just want to {i}watch?!{/i} That’s hilarious! Ahahahahahah!!!!!
lines.zh: : 你居然不想加入？！你只想{i}看{/i}？！笑死我了！啊啊哈哈哈哈哈！！！！！

lines.en: scene harukasanabar22
: Is...is joining an option? Because Sara...there’s no way she’d...
lines.zh: : 加入……加入是一个选项吗？因为 Sara……她不可能……

lines.en: : She let a man over twice my size pound me into oblivion while she fucked herself with a dildo. I don’t think another girl her age is out of the question.
lines.zh: : 她让一个比我大两倍的男人把我操到人事不省，她自己则用假阳具自慰。我觉得她那个年纪再来个女孩也不是不行。

lines.en: : {i}Besides,{/i} she’ll do anything I ask her to. That’s what {i}love{/i} is.
lines.zh: : {i}再说了{/i}，我要她做什么她都会做。这就是{i}爱{/i}啊。

lines.en: : And you...really aren’t asking for anything in return? I’m...{i}not{/i} being blackmailed?
lines.zh: : 而你……真的不要任何回报吗？我……{i}没有{/i}被勒索？

lines.en: : I might call in a {i}favor{/i} eventually. But I mostly just want Sensei to understand how much more fun his life will be if he chooses me over everyone else.
lines.zh: : 我可能会在将来讨一个{i}人情{/i}。但我主要是想让 Sensei 明白，如果他选我而不是别的任何人，他的人生会有趣得多。

lines.en: : What...kind of favor?
lines.zh: : 什么……样的人情？

lines.en: scene harukasanabar23
: I don’t know yet.
lines.zh: : 我还不知道。

lines.en: : I’d never ask you to do anything you don’t already {i}want{/i} to do in the first place, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，我绝不会要你做你一开始就根本不{i}想{/i}做的事。

lines.en: : I’m not {i}evil,{/i} Haru-chan. Just very, very mischievous. Kind of like how {i}you’re{/i} very, very curious but too afraid of getting in trouble to ever satisfy those curiosities.
lines.zh: : 我{i}不坏{/i}，Haru-chan。只是非常、非常淘气。就像{i}你{/i}一样非常、非常好奇，却又太怕惹麻烦，永远满足不了那些好奇心。

lines.en: : You’re forgetting something, though. The golden rule that governs the whole, wide world.
lines.zh: : 不过你忘了一件事。那条支配着整个广阔世界的黄金法则。

lines.en: : To...treat others the way you want to be treated?
lines.zh: : 是……己所不欲，勿施于人？

lines.en: : No, silly.
lines.zh: : 不是啦，笨蛋。

lines.en: scene harukasanabar24
: That you can get away with anything so long as you’re cute!
lines.zh: : 只要长得可爱，干什么都能被原谅！

lines.en: : Sana! I’m back with-
lines.zh: : Sana！我回来了，带——

lines.en: scene harukasanabar25
: Hi, Mom! I missed you so much...
lines.zh: : 嗨，妈妈！我好想你……

lines.en: : Sana? What’s gotten into you? Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : Sana？你怎么了？一切都好吗？

lines.en: scene harukasanabar26
: Better now that we’re together again...
lines.zh: : 我们又在一起了，就好多了……

lines.en: : Haruka. Take a picture. Now. I need this.
lines.zh: : Haruka。拍张照。现在就拍。我需要这个。

lines.en: scene harukasanabar27
: Haruka?...
lines.zh: : Haruka？……

lines.en: scene harukasanabar28
: Your face is beet red...Sana, get her some water. Haruka, what’s going on?
lines.zh: : 你脸红得跟甜菜一样……Sana，去给她拿点水。Haruka，怎么回事？

lines.en: : Uhh...n...nothing. I’m fine. Just...a little drunk, I guess...
lines.zh: : 呃……没……没什么。我没事。就是……大概有点醉了……

lines.en: : That would make sense. I’ve noticed throughout the years that you only get this red when you’re horny and drinking {i}does{/i} seem to have that effect on you.
lines.zh: : 那就说得通了。这些年来我注意到了，你只有在发情的时候才会红成这样，而喝酒似乎{i}确实{/i}对你有这种效果。

lines.en: : Ew, {i}Mom.{/i} You can’t say things like that in public...even {i}if{/i} Haruka is your friend.
lines.zh: : 恶心，{i}妈妈{/i}。你不能在外面说这种话……{i}就算{/i} Haruka 是你朋友也不行。

lines.en: : Do you see this, Haru-chan? Bear witness to the overwhelming ball of purity that is my little girl! Isn’t she just the cutest?!
lines.zh: : 你看见了吗，Haru-chan？快来见证我家小女儿那压倒性的纯洁之球！她是不是可爱到爆！

lines.en: : Yeah...
: Yeah, she really is...
lines.zh: : 嗯，她真的很可爱……

lines.en: At this point, Haruka Hamasaki {i}was{/i} gazing into the depths of a beer can and thinking about kissing teenage girls. The beer can itself just had nothing to do with it this time.
lines.zh: 此时此刻，Haruka Hamasaki {i}正{/i}凝视着啤酒罐的深处，想着亲吻少女的事。这一次，啤酒罐本身确实跟这事毫无关系。

lines.en: Sandwiched between fantasies of being sandwiched between the Sakakibaras, however, there was an indestructible and unavoidable golem crafted of guilt, though.
lines.zh: 然而，夹在「被夹在 Sakakibara 母女中间」的幻想之间的，是一尊由内疚捏成的、坚不可摧又无法回避的泥人。

lines.en: Guilt and shame. And whatever else it is that’s used to make a golem. Magic, I guess? Industrial strength glue? That part doesn’t matter much.
lines.zh: 内疚与羞耻。以及随便什么别的、用来造泥人的东西。魔法吧，我猜？工业强度胶水？那部分不太重要。

lines.en: In fact, it was difficult deciphering exactly what {i}did{/i} matter in this moment since the golem inside of her was currently battling an ancient dragon born from her lust.
lines.zh: 事实上，此刻很难弄清到底什么{i}才{/i}重要，因为她体内那尊泥人，正与一条因她的欲望而生的远古巨龙厮杀。

lines.en: “Which side do I root for?” she wonders. Because the dragon was cool and had awesome fire attacks. But the golem ran a soup kitchen for the homeless and was researching the cure for cancer in his spare time.
lines.zh: 「我该支持哪一边？」她想。因为那条龙很酷，还有超强的火焰攻击。可泥人替无家可归者开了施粥所，业余时间还在研究癌症的治疗方法。

lines.en: Like, those things are {i}nice{/i} and all sure. But those awesome fire attacks were badass and got her blood pumping the way soup never could.
lines.zh: 就是说，那些事当然是{i}好事{/i}。可那些帅气的火焰攻击实在太带感了，让她的血液沸腾，这是施粥永远做不到的。

lines.en: scene black
In the end, the dragon won because the dragon always wins. That’s how it became {i}ancient{/i} in the first place.
lines.zh: 最后，龙赢了，因为龙永远是赢家。它之所以能成为{i}远古{/i}的存在，就是这么来的。

lines.en: But for a brief moment in what will one day be a slightly less brief life, she almost switched sides.
lines.zh: 但在那段终有一天会变得稍稍不那么短暂的人生里，曾有那么一瞬间，她几乎倒戈了。

lines.en: And she still {i}likes{/i} that golem.
lines.zh: 她依然{i}喜欢{/i}那尊泥人。

lines.en: She really does.
lines.zh: 真的喜欢。

lines.en: She just likes him more when he’s fighting someone else’s battles.
lines.zh: 她只是在他去打别人的仗时，更喜欢他一些。

{i}Haruka’s affection has increased to [haruka_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}But she doesn’t make any character progress because this is the route where she only gets worse and everything ends horribly.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}但她没有任何角色成长，因为在这条路线里她只会越变越糟，而一切都会以惨剧收场。{/i}
